content_metadata.description: This story follows Julia as she embarks on her adventure in a van, exploring themes of fear, resilience, and freedom. Julia navigates her concerns and excitement about living a life on the road, highlighting her van's features and sharing her experiences with her travel companion, Canyon, and her friend, Chris.
